name: Mikagura Shoujo Tanteidan
source:
At the beginning of the Taisho Era there was a man in Tokyo running his private detective agency, and Mikagura Tokita was his name.
Three young girls attracted by his genius joined him to help with his job.
Will there be any culprit who would surpass their united wits?
translation:
大正初期，东京有一位男子经营着自己的私人侦探社，他的名字叫三神乐时田。
三个年轻女孩被他的天才所吸引，加入他来帮助他完成工作。
到底会有什么罪魁祸首能够超越他们的智慧呢？
